title: Anthropic Hackathon Winner Leaked His Entire AI Coding Setup!  #ai #technology #aitutorial
description:
The winner of the Anthropic Hackathon just open-sourced his entire AI coding setup for FREE! 🚀

In this video, Tessa breaks down Everything Claude Code (ECC)—the 200,000+ star GitHub repository created by hackathon winner Affaan Mustafa. Refined over 10 months of daily use, this system isn't just another prompt pack; it’s a complete development OS packed with 100+ battle-tested skills, autonomous sub-agents, and security tools.

Watch to learn how to install this MIT-licensed repository and upgrade your Claude Code setup today!

💡 Key Takeaways:

How Everything Claude Code automates feature planning, code reviews, and testing.

Difference between Claude skills (capability upgrades) and sub-agents (delegated helpers).

Installing MIT-licensed open-source configs for Claude Code.

🔔 Subscribe for daily AI breakdowns, Claude tips, and open-source tech news!
